metadata.title: Company SOC worked example — 7 controls — DEMO ONLY
metadata.remarks: Fictional training example selected from NIST SP800-53 Rev. 5.2.0. This is not a NIST Low or Moderate baseline, a complete security requirement set, or evidence of compliance. All ODP values and additional context are illustrative company assumptions.

parts.name: item
parts.title: Demo context — logging scope
parts.prose: For this fictional service, the system owner records enabled event types and delivery frequency in a telemetry register. The SOC reviews a sample of each event type during onboarding; application teams explain exclusions.

parts.name: item
parts.title: Demo context — review evidence
parts.prose: The daily review records the query period, analyst, findings and related case IDs. A missing-log alert is investigated as a coverage issue even when no threat alert is raised.

parts.name: item
parts.title: Demo context — containment decisions
parts.prose: The SOC proposes containment in the incident case and records the decision. The system owner authorizes actions affecting availability; the incident manager coordinates recovery with the business continuity lead.

parts.name: item
parts.title: Demo context — reporting route
parts.prose: Personnel report suspected incidents through the monitored incident portal or duty telephone within the assigned one-hour window. The SOC acknowledges receipt, records discovery and report times, and escalates urgent cases immediately.

parts.name: item
parts.title: Demo context — monitoring boundary
parts.prose: Monitoring covers only assets accepted into the telemetry register. The daily summary identifies disconnected sensors and unmonitored assets alongside threat findings; the system owner owns remediation of these gaps.
